INSERT INTO T_REVENUE_RECOGNITION ( RECOGNITION_ID, CONTRACT_ID, RECOGNITION_TYPE, RECOGNITION_PERIOD, RECOGNITION_DATE, RECOGNITION_AMOUNT, CUMULATIVE_AMOUNT, RECOGNITION_RATE, PERFORMANCE_PROGRESS, RECOGNITION_BASIS, VOUCHER_ID, BOOK_ID, TENANT_ID, VERSION, IS_DELETED, CREATE_TIME, UPDATE_TIME, CREATOR, UPDATER ) VALUES ( #{recognitionId}, #{contractId}, #{recognitionType}, #{recognitionPeriod}, #{recognitionDate}, #{recognitionAmount}, #{cumulativeAmount}, #{recognitionRate}, #{performanceProgress}, #{recognitionBasis}, #{voucherId}, #{bookId}, #{tenantId}, #{version}, #{isDeleted}, #{createTime}, #{updateTime}, #{creator}, #{updater} )
mapper.select: SELECT rr.RECOGNITION_ID as recognitionId, rr.CONTRACT_ID as contractId, rc.CONTRACT_NO as contractNo, rc.CONTRACT_NAME as contractName, rc.CONTRACT_AMOUNT as contractAmount, rc.CUSTOMER_ID as customerId, rr.RECOGNITION_PERIOD as recognitionPeriod, rr.RECOGNITION_DATE as recognitionDate, rr.RECOGNITION_AMOUNT as recognitionAmount, rr.CUMULATIVE_AMOUNT as cumulativeAmount, rr.RECOGNITION_RATE as recognitionRate, rr.PERFORMANCE_PROGRESS as performanceProgress, rr.RECOGNITION_TYPE as recognitionType, CASE rr.RECOGNITION_TYPE WHEN 1 THEN '自动确认' WHEN 2 THEN '手动确认' ELSE '未知' END as recognitionTypeName, rr.RECOGNITION_BASIS as recognitionBasis, rr.VOUCHER_ID as voucherId, rr.BOOK_ID as bookId, rr.TENANT_ID as tenantId, rr.CREATE_TIME as createTime, rr.UPDATE_TIME as updateTime, rr.CREATOR as creator, rr.UPDATER as updater, (rc.CONTRACT_AMOUNT - rr.CUMULATIVE_AMOUNT) as remainingRevenue FROM T_REVENUE_RECOGNITION rr LEFT JOIN T_REVENUE_CONTRACT rc ON rr.CONTRACT_ID = rc.CONTRACT_ID WHERE rr.RECOGNITION_ID = #{recognitionId} AND rr.IS_DELETED = 0

SELECT v.VOUCHER_ID as voucherId, v.VOUCHER_NO as voucherNo, v.VOUCHER_TYPE as voucherType, CASE v.VOUCHER_TYPE WHEN 1 THEN '收款凭证' WHEN 2 THEN '付款凭证' WHEN 3 THEN '转账凭证' WHEN 4 THEN '记账凭证' ELSE '其他' END as voucherTypeName, v.VOUCHER_DATE as voucherDate, v.ACCOUNTING_PERIOD as accountingPeriod, v.DEBIT_AMOUNT as debitAmount, v.CREDIT_AMOUNT as creditAmount, v.SUMMARY as summary, v.VOUCHER_STATUS as voucherStatus, CASE v.VOUCHER_STATUS WHEN 0 THEN '草稿' WHEN 1 THEN '已审核' WHEN 2 THEN '已过账' WHEN 3 THEN '已作废' ELSE '未知' END as voucherStatusName, v.CREATOR_NAME as creatorName, v.CREATE_TIME as createTime, v.AUDITOR_NAME as auditorName, v.AUDIT_TIME as auditTime FROM T_VOUCHER v INNER JOIN T_REVENUE_RECOGNITION rr ON rr.VOUCHER_ID = v.VOUCHER_ID WHERE rr.RECOGNITION_ID = #{recognitionId} AND rr.IS_DELETED = 0 AND v.IS_DELETED = 0
